d: Saudi Arabia has extended the repayment deadline on a $3 billion loan to Pakistan. Islamabad had received the money in April after facing a $3.5 billion repayment to the United Arab Emirates, effectively taking a new loan to repay an older one. But Saudi support for Pakistan goes back decades. Riyadh has provided financial and diplomatic assistance since Pakistan’s early years, while Pakistani troops have served in Saudi Arabia and helped train and support its armed forces. The relationship has since expanded into a broader defence partnership.
